assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The procedure is documented in the clinical indication note
The procedure is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent symptomatic episodes
